topic: Pre-main ecosystem title, visual polish, and performance guardrails
currentUserGoal: Prepare the ecosystem redesign for a possible master promotion by always starting the real game at a title screen, offering Continue and New Field choices, polishing presentation, and tightening performance without changing the direct developer playtest route.
workCompleted: Changed the bare production URL and ?alpha alias to register EcosystemTitleScene before EcosystemPrototypeScene.
Kept ?redesign&ecosystemPrototype as a direct title-bypass developer route, kept ?redesign on the previous redesign, and preserved ?legacy plus legacy harness routing.

Built a responsive ecosystem title screen using the established landscape and portrait title art, emerald nine-slice panels and buttons, title selectors, lightweight ambient field motes, ALPHA identity, options, credits, and polished transitions.
Added Continue Field and Return to Memory Grove labels based on the saved active-field state.
Added a two-step confirmed Begin New Field action that clears only ecosystem permanent and active saves.
Added title-screen save summaries for run number, field size, HP, elapsed time, touches, completed runs, and permanent GT.
Added working music and SFX sliders to the title options screen and mirrored title actions and sliders into real semantic HTML controls for agent and keyboard accessibility.
Kept the ecosystem on lucid-field-theme.wav instead of restoring the obsolete legacy menu soundtrack.
Deferred the multi-megabyte Lucid music load until the title or field has rendered its first usable visual state; the decoded audio cache is shared by both scenes.
Added a production-only Return to Title action to the ecosystem Options screen. The direct ecosystemPrototype route intentionally hides it.
Added subtle root entrance transitions for field, Memory Grove, Ecosystem Works, Options, and next-run transitions, plus improved shared button hover, press, disabled, and stroke feedback.

Hardened title and ecosystem scene restarts so returning to the title and continuing again clears stale pooled display-object references, DOM controls, music references, timers, and performance counters.
Bound near-field per-frame motion to 144 representative tile transforms on desktop and 72 on phone while distributing the sample across visible pooled tiles.

Reset rendered tile transforms during projection redraws, cached first-sprinkler affordability for its attention animation, reduced heavy playtest snapshot refreshes from four to two per second, and exposed animatedTileViews in the ecosystem harness.
Updated the ecosystem design, project manual, and performance notes for the new production route and guardrails.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 155 Vitest tests across 20 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Focused route, ecosystem save, and animation-budget suites passed 24 tests.
git diff --check passed with only expected Windows line-ending warnings.
The local server returned HTTP 200 for /, /?alpha, and /?redesign&ecosystemPrototype&playtest.
No external or headless Chrome process was launched. Final visual feel still needs the user's in-app hands-on pass.

release.status: Verified branch checkpoint. Not merged into master, pushed as this slice, or promoted to production yet.

knownIssues: Desktop and 390x844 visual placement, title audio autoplay behavior, and the full title -> game -> title -> game loop need a hands-on browser pass before master promotion.

New numeric performance claims were not recorded in this session. The structural animation and startup guardrails should be rechecked through the ecosystem-specific debug harness after the visual test.
The title and field intentionally share the Lucid track. A distinct new-canon title composition can replace it later without changing the startup flow.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless explicitly requested.
nextRecommendedSteps: Open the bare local URL and verify that it always starts at the title, even when the active save is currently in Memory Grove.
Test Continue Field, Return to Memory Grove, the two-step New Field confirmation, both title audio sliders, and Return to Title from in-game Options.
Check the title and game at 1280x720 and 390x844, then use the ecosystem debug route to compare ordinary 1x1 and 100x100 animation/frame metrics.
If the hands-on pass is approved, push this branch, merge it into master, deploy production, and run the Mac handoff workflow.
doNotRevert: Do not route the bare production URL directly into active gameplay or Memory Grove.
Do not restore epic_menu_theme_mellow.wav to the ecosystem redesign.
Keep the direct ecosystemPrototype route available for developer and performance testing.
Keep title and gameplay semantic DOM controls intact.
Do not cite the legacy 1,200-tile harness as ecosystem performance evidence.
Do not touch docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
